description: Build a fixed asset's depreciation schedule. Method macrs_half_year uses the IRS's own MACRS GDS percentages for 3-, 5-, 7-, 10-, 15- and 20-year property with the half-year convention (IRS Publication 946, Table A-1). Method straight_line spreads cost minus salvage over a useful life in years, either a full year in year one or half a year in year one and in the year after the last. Send the cost (basis), the method, the recovery period or useful life, and optionally the first year. Get back each year's depreciation, the running total and the remaining book value, ending at exactly the depreciable amount. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/depreciation-schedule). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

convention.description: straight_line first-year convention: full_year (default) or half_year.

cost.description: Depreciable basis (cost, after any section 179 or bonus amount you took elsewhere).

first_year.description: Optional calendar or tax year the asset was placed in service (labels the rows).

label.description: Optional asset label (your own text, echoed).

recovery_years.description: MACRS recovery period in years (method macrs_half_year).

salvage.description: Salvage value (straight_line only; MACRS ignores salvage).

name: depreciation_schedule
title: Depreciation Schedule (MACRS and Straight Line)
